## Why This Is Asked
This question probes end-to-end validation of a streaming, lakehouse-backed pipeline under real-world pressure, including multi-tenant isolation, schema evolution, and canary deployments.

## Key Concepts
- End-to-end streaming tests across API, Kafka, Spark, Delta Lake
- Schema evolution and versioning in Delta Lake
- Multi-tenant data isolation and reconciliation
- Canary feature flags and fault injection
- Observability and SLA verification

## Code Example
```python

def test_e2e_streaming_pipeline():
  seed_tenants(['t1','t2'])
  enable_canary('new_schema')
  generate_events(rate=1_000_000, duration=60)
  assert dashboards.counts_matches_source()
  inject_faults(['region_latency','network_partition'])
  replay_duplicate_events()
  assert idempotence()
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle late-arriving data in this pipeline?
- What metrics would you collect to distinguish processing latency vs. data skew?

Tests the complexity of offline-first data integrity and cross-device conflicts under realistic workloads.

## Key Concepts

- Offline-first synchronization, IndexedDB, service workers
- Conflict resolution using revision IDs and last-write-wins
- Multi-tenant data isolation, audit logging, and latency under burst

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudocode: conflict resolver
function resolveNote(note, incoming) {
  return (incoming.rev >= note.rev) ? incoming : note;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you simulate unreliable networks (2G) and partial failures?
- How would you verify exact audit trail events across tenants?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests cross-system data synchronization, CDC reliability, and privacy controls in a realistic enterprise integration.

## Key Concepts
- CDC pipelines, idempotent processing, upsert semantics, deduplication
- Field-level mappings, PII masking, audit trails, regional latency
- Failure injection, SLA adherence, data isolation

## Code Example
```javascript
// pseudo: verify mapping between SF Lead and Oracle row after upsert
function verifyLeadMappings(sfLead, oraRow){
  return sfLead.name===oraRow.name && sfLead.email===oraRow.emailMasked && oraRow.pk>0;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test multi-tenant isolation and cross-region replication?
- How would you simulate repeated replay safety for late-arriving events?
